body:
## Summary
- Reconstructed the latest owner feedback from `game_log_20260416_223640.txt`: `FLANKING` was technically starting, but 12 of 15 starts collapsed back to `COMBAT`, often in the same timestamp bucket, so the maneuver was not visible in gameplay.
- Added a small `FLANKING` commitment gate: enemies now need either `FLANK_MIN_COMMIT_TIME` or `FLANK_MIN_COMMIT_DISTANCE` before a newly-started flank can exit back to `COMBAT` just because the target becomes hittable.
- Fixed the remaining `PURSUING` regression from the same feedback: combat-path and passage-waypoint fallbacks now reject local anchors that move a distant enemy farther away from the player.
- Fixed the current CI/GUT startup hang: `PersistManager` no longer opens the first-launch difficulty picker during GUT command-line runs, because that pauses the tree before await-based tests can resume.
- Preserved the latest attached log, PR metadata, verification logs, and the updated issue case study under `docs/case-studies/issue-1814/`.

## Latest Evidence
- Latest owner log: [`game_log_20260416_223640.txt`](https://github.com/konard/Jhon-Crow-godot-topdown-MVP/blob/issue-1814-67b54615dfb8/docs/case-studies/issue-1814/game_log_20260416_223640.txt?raw=true)
- Log counts from the latest attachment: 15 `FLANKING started`, 12 `State: FLANKING -> COMBAT`, 49 `COMBAT -> PURSUING`, and 786 `PURSUING corner check` entries.
- The key failure pattern was a one-frame `FLANKING -> COMBAT` collapse plus pursuit fallback waypoints that could still increase distance to the player.

## Case Study Evidence
Latest Building screenshot bundle preserved in the branch:

![Issue 1814 screenshot 1](https://github.com/konard/Jhon-Crow-godot-topdown-MVP/blob/issue-1814-67b54615dfb8/docs/case-studies/issue-1814/images/issue-1814-screenshot-1.png?raw=true)

![Issue 1814 screenshot 2](https://github.com/konard/Jhon-Crow-godot-topdown-MVP/blob/issue-1814-67b54615dfb8/docs/case-studies/issue-1814/images/issue-1814-screenshot-2.png?raw=true)

![Issue 1814 screenshot 3](https://github.com/konard/Jhon-Crow-godot-topdown-MVP/blob/issue-1814-67b54615dfb8/docs/case-studies/issue-1814/images/issue-1814-screenshot-3.png?raw=true)

## Verification
- `git diff --check`
- Architecture line-count check: `scripts/objects/enemy.gd` is 4938 lines, below the 5000-line CI limit.
- `dotnet build GodotTopDownTemplate.sln --configuration Debug` completed with 0 errors; 94 existing nullable/unreachable-code warnings remain in unrelated C# files.
- Targeted GUT filter `flanking`: 11 tests, 11 passing.
- Targeted GUT filter `attacking_rejects_fallback`: 1 test, 1 passing.
- Targeted GUT filter `passage_waypoint_fallback`: 2 tests, 2 passing.
- Targeted GUT filter `first_launch`: 17 tests, 17 passing.
- Targeted GUT filter `ready_flag_set`: 1 test, 1 passing; this verifies the previous GUT startup pause no longer blocks the first await-based test.
- Full local GUT now proceeds past the prior startup hang, but the repository still has unrelated pre-existing full-suite failures; the focused regressions above pass.

Fixes Jhon-Crow/godot-topdown-MVP#1814
title: Fix Building flanking and pursuit fallback
